title: Hindenburgstraße, Denzlingen
description:
Minimum stay: 2 months
Maximum stay: 4 months
Not suitable for shared living – rental to single persons only

Only available for demonstrable short-term stays - like academic studies, research project, project work, etc.

Fully furnished and very cozy 2.5-room apartment with private terrace and a green view. Ideal for nature lovers who still want to live close to the center.

Perfect for dual students, visiting researchers, or professionals with a temporary stay in the region.

The apartment is on the ground floor of a multi-family house, centrally located in Denzlingen. Supermarkets, restaurants, pharmacies, a drugstore, and the train/bus station are all within walking distance. Freiburg main station can be reached in just a few minutes by train.

Details:

The apartment is used by the owner when not rented
Rent: €950 (incl. utilities)
Security deposit: €(hidden) (depending on the length of your stay)
Tourist stays are strictly prohibited by local authorities

No smoking, no pets

Upon request: linen package (bed linen + towels) available for a one-time fee of €50

Amenities:

Fully equipped kitchen
Senseo coffee machine
Microwave
Stove with oven
Basic cookware and dishes
Wi-Fi
Washing machine (shared, in utility room of main building)
Private terrace


Feel free to contact me if you have any  questions

Sonstiges
Contact via email

title: Eugen-Martin-Straße, Freiburg
description:
The modern furnished studio offers a double bed, a fully equipped kitchen, a working area, a bathroom with shower and toilet, flat screen TV, air conditioning and free Wi-Fi.
The apartment is comfortably furnished. Fully equipped kitchen, multifunctional working and living area, modern bathroom: you will feel like at home while benefiting from our full range of services. 

Weekly cleaning as well as changing bed sheets and towels is included in the price. Cleaning also possible on request.

- Parking in the parking garage of the building: EUR 18,00 per night
- Washing machine (EUR 4 per load) and dryer (EUR 2 per load) as well as an iron are located inside the building (not inside the studio apartment) available to the guests in the building.
- Guests bringing their pets: EUR 5,00 - 10,00 per night.

In just 10 minutes you can reach the city center by streetcar, putting you in a prime location. Discover Freiburg, the southernmost city in Germany, the Freiburg Cathedral and the historical buildings or admire the pretty alleys of the Klein-Venedig district. The Messe Freiburg, Sick Arena and the new stadium of the SC Freiburg are also in the immediate vicinity.
